description: Jobs conformance (JOB-01): scenarios of @jsails/jobs/testing that today's jsails/jobs runtime fails, plus the shipped jsails work wiring and the two-process memory-adapter split. Entries on legacy-*.test.ts record defects of the old runtime: fixedBy names the package whose new runtime passes the scenario on its own driver; the legacy driver and its entries are deleted in JOB-08 at the latest. The same scenarios, less the virtual-time schedules group, fail on the BullMQ adapter against a live Valkey: legacy-valkey.test.ts runs only with JSAILS_TEST_VALKEY=1 and VALKEY_URL, so its entries are scoped to runs that declare the valkey service (the jobs stage of verify:integrations). legacy-memory-explicit-overlap.test.ts runs the overlap scenarios with overlap registered by hand after the chain middleware, where the runtime installs no automatic overlap. packages/jobs/test/memory/conformance.test.ts runs the same scenarios on the new @jsails/jobs code (defineJob, the producer, the envelope and memoryJobs) with a stand-in processor; its entries name the work package that supplies the missing piece: the worker runtime with bounded abort (JOB-03) or flows, failed-job operations, overlap leases and schedules (JOB-04).

test: a key still deduplicates after the first job was evicted

failure.message: ran again after the first job completed and was evicted
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: A key is a jobId, and both adapters free a jobId once the job completes (the memory adapter at once, BullMQ at retention eviction), so the key has no window.

test: a retried attempt sees the stored payload, not the previous attempt mutation

failure.message: each attempt should start from the stored payload; the handler counted \[2,2\]
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: The memory adapter hands every attempt the same payload object it was given at dispatch, so a handler that mutates its payload changes what the retry sees; a serializing transport stores a copy.

test: an in-flight handler can dispatch while its worker drains

failure.message: an in-flight handler could not dispatch while its worker drained
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: close() marks the whole runtime closed before draining, so ctx.dispatch from an in-flight handler throws JobsRuntimeClosedError and the handler fails.

test: an overlap skip is reported as skipped, not completed

failure.message: an overlap skip was not reported as skipped
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: The overlap middleware returns without calling the handler; no event is emitted and the adapter counts the attempt as completed.

test: abort is bounded with a middleware that never returns

failure.message: abort did not resolve within 5000 ms with a middleware that never returns
failure.name: Error

entries.reason: Only the handler is raced against the abort signal; middleware runs outside the race, and the memory adapter's force close returns the graceful close promise, so shutdown waits for the middleware forever.

test: a job never runs alongside its own attempt abandoned by abort

failure.message: a job ran alongside its own abandoned attempt \(2 runs in flight\)
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: An aborted attempt is requeued as soon as the race rejects while its handler keeps running, so the next worker runs the job concurrently with it (no grace or poisoned-worker rule).

test: a batch with an invalid item enqueues nothing

failure.message: a batch with an invalid item enqueued 3 of its items
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: createJobBatch registers the batch and dispatches items concurrently; payloads are validated per dispatch, so valid items are enqueued before the invalid one throws, and the batch can never settle.

test: a redelivered chain step does not enqueue the next step twice

failure.message: redelivering chain step 1 ran step 2 2 times
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: chainMiddleware dispatches the next step with no key after every successful run, so a redelivered step forks the chain.

test: batch callbacks fire after the producer restarts

failure.message: batch callbacks after a producer restart fired \{"then":0,"catch":0,"finally":0\}
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: Batch callbacks are closures held in the registering process (SharedBatchCoordinator keeps only progress in the store), so they are lost when that process restarts.

test: batch status counts children and reports settlement

failure.message: the implementation reports no batch status
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: The legacy batch API has no status read; progress lives in coordinator-private keys.

test: retrying a failed chain step continues the chain

failure.message: retrying a failed chain step did not continue the chain \(0 runs of the next step\)
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: queue:retry replays only allowlisted options and drops the chain descriptor, so a retried step cannot rejoin its chain.

test: a 30-day interval fires once in its first 30 days

failure.message: cannot hold a schedule interval longer than 2147483647 ms
failure.name: JobsRuntimeError

entries.reason: The memory adapter refuses an interval above the Node timer limit (the M0 guard against the 1 ms clamp) instead of holding it with a long timer. setLongInterval exists since JOB-02; the new memory driver runs schedules on it in JOB-04.

test: a job unknown to a worker is released, then run by a worker that knows it

failure.message: a job unknown to the first worker was not left for a worker that knows it
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: An unknown job name fails terminally (JobNotRegisteredError marked non-retryable) instead of being released, so a worker of an older release burns jobs of a newer one.

test: an overlap skip is reported as skipped, not completed

failure.message: an overlap skip was not reported as skipped
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: With overlap registered by hand the middleware still returns without calling the handler; no event is emitted and the adapter counts the attempt as completed.

test: an overlap skip does not advance a chain

failure.message: an overlap-skipped chain step advanced the chain
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: With the documented per-job stack [chainMiddleware, batch, createOverlapMiddleware(mutex)] the runtime adds no automatic overlap, so overlap runs inside chainMiddleware; it skips without running the handler, next() resolves, and chainMiddleware dispatches the next step.

test: a key still deduplicates after the first job was evicted

failure.message: ran again after the first job completed and was evicted
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: A key is a jobId, and BullMQ frees a jobId once the completed job is evicted (removeOnComplete), so the key has no window. The new memory driver holds the window (JOB-02); the Valkey transport maps keys to a deduplication ttl in JOB-05.

test: a job dispatched in another process than the worker is run or refused

failure.message: neither run nor refused
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: The memory adapter is process-local and declares no reach, so splitting producer and worker over it silently loses jobs instead of being refused with adapter_not_shared.

test: a chain advances on a worker started by jsails work

failure.message: jsails work ran \["first"\] of a two-step chain
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: jobsRuntimeOptions passes no middleware and the runtime config has no field for it, so chainMiddleware never runs under jsails work; only a hand-built runtime can chain. The test is deleted with the old work command in JOB-08.

test: a batch settles on a worker started by jsails work

failure.message: a batch on a jsails work worker settled 0 times
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: jsails work registers no batch middleware, so batch children never record progress and callbacks never fire. The test is deleted with the old work command in JOB-08.
